# ENV-007 PG 侧认证对照实验（2026-09-01）

===== 0. 准备 lab_auth 角色 =====
NOTICE:  role "lab_auth" does not exist, skipping
DROP ROLE
CREATE ROLE
lab_auth|t|SCRAM-SHA-256$4096:w
scram-sha-256

===== 1. trust 认证（pg_hba: 127.0.0.1 trust）→ 免密成功 =====
--- psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U lab_auth（无密码）
 current_user 
--------------
 lab_auth
(1 row)


===== 2. md5/scram 认证（pg_hba: 192.168.101.0/24 md5；密码存 scram 时按 scram 交换） =====
--- 正确密码（PGPASSWORD）
 current_user 
--------------
 lab_auth
(1 row)

--- 错误密码 → FATAL password authentication failed
psql: error: connection to server at "192.168.101.129", port 54184 failed: FATAL:  password authentication failed for user "lab_auth"
--- 缺密码 → FATAL no password supplied
Password for user lab_auth: 
psql: error: connection to server at "192.168.101.129", port 54184 failed: fe_sendauth: no password supplied

===== 3. 角色与来源解耦（同一角色，两条 hba 行两种认证） =====
--- 同一 lab_auth：trust 来源
trust-ok
--- 同一 lab_auth：md5 来源
md5-ok

===== 4. 清理 =====
DROP ROLE
DONE
